prompts.roster:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: version-two character design lineup for an original skill-based soccer game.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing project's SIX CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Preserve the six identities, outfit color families, hairstyles and sport roles, while intentionally redesigning the proportions and expressions.
Primary request: make these athletes much more playful, funny and appealing for a lively future-city street soccer league. Exactly six original adult athletes, full bodies, left to right Wind Shuttle, Iron Guard, Arc Light, Echo, Magnet Core, Jump Point, on a clean warm ivory studio background.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted cartoon 2.5D game art, rounded chunky forms, bold dark navy outer outlines, very simple two-tone cel shading plus soft ambient volume, expressive oversized heads and hands, approximately 2.6-head-tall caricature proportions, oversized rounded sneakers, warm sunny upper-left light. Clearly readable faces, relaxed comic confidence and bouncy ready-to-play posture. Less anime realism and less armor detail than reference.
Character identities: Wind Shuttle is a tiny slim teal-haired female runner in cream/teal cropped sports jacket and dark trousers with wing-shaped heel accents, mischievous grin. Iron Guard is a very wide sturdy brown-haired male defender in cream/orange padded sportswear, rounded forearm sports pads and huge orange sneakers, cheerful determined eyebrows. Arc Light is a slim purple-haired female shooter, tied hair, plum/cream tracksuit and one chunky technical shooting boot, confident cheeky smirk. Echo is a warm brown-skinned curly-haired female organizer, ivory/turquoise sportswear, round pulse bracelets, friendly open expression. Magnet Core is a stocky navy/gold male player, compact circular hip equipment and heavy sports shoes, amusingly serious expression. Jump Point is a small blue-black-haired nimble male player in coral/cream hoodie and spring shin pieces, energetic raised heel.
Camera: coherent slightly elevated orthographic three-quarter design view; see faces, front of torso, side of bodies and top of shoes. This is NOT overhead. Their full volumes should read like charming hand-painted game figurines, while remaining 2D illustrations.
Composition: horizontal wide lineup, evenly spaced, generous margins, no overlapping silhouettes, aligned foot baselines, no ball or other props between characters. No captions, no logos, no text, no weapons, no interface, no copied game characters. Preserve each original athlete's identity and role, make their silhouettes more exaggerated and their style more fun.
prompts.arena:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: empty layered arena background for a 2.5D hand-painted cartoon skill-soccer game.
Input images: Image 1 is the previous arena, a redesign target for its future-city sports identity and green floor. Image 2 is the new character lineup, a style and palette reference only, do not insert characters.
Primary request: redesign the flat overhead industrial sports arena into a much more playful bright future-city street-league court with modest visible volume.
Camera/composition: landscape 16:9 orthographic camera looking downward at approximately 55 degrees ABOVE THE HORIZONTAL ground, zero horizontal yaw. The length of the rectangular court runs left to right, far and near long edges remain exactly horizontal and parallel, short edges vertical in screen space. See the top surfaces AND front side faces of benches, low walls, planters and raised platform. This is a slightly tilted game view, NOT 90 degree overhead, NOT a rotated diamond isometric court, no vanishing point or trapezoid. Keep entire rectangular arena visible.
Layout: central calm desaturated mint/teal green empty playing floor spans about x=8% to 92% and y=14% to 87% of image. A future exact line overlay will occupy x=10% to 90%, y=17% to 83%, so keep ALL that area empty green, low contrast and completely clear. Leave the left and right middle edges clear for separate goal sprites. No goals yet. No field markings, NO center circle, NO white lines painted anywhere on the floor. Only subtle broad panels and alternating very soft green bands.
Outer perimeter: rounded cream and slate-blue low rail modules, small teal and amber sport accents, short bench seating at the back edge, chunky rounded shrub planters in outer corners, a few quiet playful geometric sports pennants along the far edge only, soft small shadows. Front edge shows a shallow visible platform fascia and material thickness, with unobtrusive rounded bumper details BELOW the playing floor, never covering it. Keep visual balance between left and right.
Style/medium: charming polished cartoon game illustration, chunky rounded forms, dark navy outlines, simplified cel shading and soft volume, warm sunny light from upper left, brighter and friendlier than previous dark industrial texture, clean visual hierarchy. Green playable floor has lowest contrast, off-court objects show height and side faces. Sports equipment, not militaristic machinery.
Constraints: empty arena, no people, no ball, no field lines, no soccer goals, no text, no logos, no UI, no horizon, no skyline, no perspective convergence, no watermark. True flat orthographic projection of ground with visible depth on raised objects.
prompts.wind-shuttle:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE isolated transparent static gameplay character sprite for an original 2.5D skill-soccer game.
Input images: Image 1 is the version-two lineup and identity reference only. Use the described single character; no lineup, no other subjects.
Style/medium: playful hand-painted cartoon game sprite, chunky rounded shapes, bold clean dark navy outside contour, very simple two-tone cel shading and soft volumetric highlights. Deliberately stylized compact THREE-HEAD-TALL body, larger expressive head, chunky rounded sneakers, simplified equipment. Warm consistent upper-left light, darker lower-right side faces. Faces and volume MUST remain readable at 96 screen pixels tall.
Camera: slightly elevated orthographic three-quarter gameplay view, camera approximately 55 degrees above ground, facing southeast toward bottom-right of image. See the FACE with both eyes and expression, front/side of torso, hair top and shoe tops. No overhead crown-only view, no front portrait camera. Standing relaxed ready-to-play idle pose, both shoes planted on the same ground plane, knees softly bent, arms slightly away from torso. Feet align near bottom of silhouette, no leaning out of balance.
Composition: one full body centered on a square canvas, generous fully transparent margin on all sides, no cropping, character fills about 70 percent of canvas height. SINGLE static frame, not sprite sheet.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency, no background color, no floor, no cast shadow (shadow is separate in game), no ball, no team rings, no effects, no halo, no text, no logos, no interface, no checkerboard baked into the pixels, no weapons, no extra characters.
Subject: Wind Shuttle, the FIRST athlete in reference: a small slim agile adult female runner, distinctive swept teal hair, cream cropped sports jacket with teal cuffs, dark loose sports trousers and oversized teal/cream sneakers with small wing-shaped heel motifs. Preserve her face, hairstyle and color identity. Give her a mischievous wide smile and raised playful eyebrow. Compact light runner silhouette; no motion trail. Render ONLY Wind Shuttle.
